name: has_background
cmd: grep -qiE '背景|现状|市场|玩家|时间线' report.md && echo BG=1 || echo BG=0

name: has_decision
cmd: grep -qiE 'go|no-go|不做|值得|不值得|建议' report.md && echo DECISION=1 || echo DECISION=0

name: has_how
cmd: grep -qiE '怎么做|技术路线|架构|切入|护城河|成本' report.md && echo HOW=1 || echo HOW=0

name: source_or_speculation_tagged
cmd: grep -qiE '推测|未核实|来源|http|引用' report.md && echo SRC=1 || echo SRC=0
